# A fixed protected-paths.txt for TestProtectHarness (apps/api/tools/harness/protectharness_test.go): its allowed
# rows run against this list, not the repo's, so a product that protects more paths keeps them green; its blocked
# rows run against the repo's list. Each allowed path is a near miss of a glob here (apps/api/AGENTS.md of
# AGENTS.md), a read of a file one matches, or product code no glob names (api/openapi.yaml). Same format as
# scripts/harness/protected-paths.txt; the globs are a subset of the template's on 2026-11-06.
